answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 44 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a dawn bet on surviving 44 epochs of grading, and every wharf settlement recomputes the gale schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
